description: .NET 10 SDK with the .NET and ASP.NET Core runtimes (dotnet CLI, C#, F#, templates).
notes: Official .NET SDK ZIP from builds.dotnet.microsoft.com. Microsoft publishes SHA512; the SHA256 was computed from the download after the SHA512 matched. Telemetry is off for processes OpenMind starts; the SDK's first run is told not to add its global-tools folder to your PATH and not to create an HTTPS development certificate (both would change your Windows user settings); NuGet's packages, HTTP cache and plugin cache go to the app's cache folder. NuGet itself still creates its user-wide %APPDATA%\NuGet\NuGet.Config (a default nuget.org source) the first time a project is restored; OpenMind can't redirect that file. This is modern .NET, not the Windows-only .NET Framework (a system component OpenMind only detects). WinForms/WPF build here; MAUI needs extra workloads and platform SDKs.
